description: Sonder-Edge bridge — reads the MTConnect agent and re-publishes the SMProfile-CNC-Machine attributes on an embedded OPC-UA server (ns=2;s=<machineId>/<smAttribute>) so a standard OSF OPC-UA edge can ingest it.
